Accomplishment
1. Fellow of the Royal Statistical Society (英國皇家統計學會院士)

2. Fellow of the American Statistical Association (美國統計學會院士)

3. Elected Member of the International Statistical Institute (國際統計學會院士)

4.The Education Advisory Committee of Upper Dublin School District (美國賓州上都柏林學區教育諮詢委員會委員) 1993,1994

5. Founding President of Taiwanese Hakka Association of Greater Philadelphia (大費城台灣客家同鄉會創會會長) 1999

6. President of Taiwanese Association of America-Greater Philadelphia Chapter (TAAGP) (大費城台灣同鄉會會長) 2001

7. President of Pennsylvania Branch of Taiwanese Association for Public Affairs (台灣人公共事務會賓州分會會長) 2002,2003

8. Chair of the TAAGP High School Scholarship Committee (美國大費城社區高中獎學金評審委員會主任委員) 2003,2004

9. President of Taiwanese Hakka Association-East Coast (美東台灣客家同鄉會會長) 2004,2005

10. President of Taiwanese Hakka Association for Public Affairs in North America (北美台灣客家公共事務協會會長) 2005,2006

11. Board Member of North America Taiwanese Professors’ Association (北美洲台灣人教授協會理事) 2006, 2007

12. President of Taiwanese Hakka Associations of America (美洲台灣客家聯合會會長) 2014, 2015

13. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 10/2018
